assertions.name: em_correction_reproduces_bare12_residual_within_one_percent
assertions.unit: relative gap between (α_em/π)/dim H_3 and (12 − k_required)
assertions.source: Route A: (α_em/π)/dim H_3 from the fine-structure constant and |S_3| — no mass, no knot. Route B: 12 − k_required from m_μ/m_p/m_e and the Borromean Markov trace at q₀ — no EM coupling. Tolerance = the 1% empirical-fit threshold the verdict cites; measured 0.803%, NOT the 0.17% the docstring claims.

assertions.name: dim_H_3_equals_sum_of_squares_of_S3_irrep_dims
assertions.source: Route A: the dim_H_3 the correction divides by. Route B: Σ_{λ⊢3} (f^λ)² = 1²+2²+1² rebuilt from the hook-length formula over the partitions of 3 (Wedderburn: = |S_3| = 3!). Ties the Plancherel reading of the 6 to the |S_3| reading instead of leaving the docstring's ambiguity unchecked.

assertions.name: alpha_em_literal_matches_codata_registry
assertions.source: Route A: the 137.0359991 hard-typed in this file. Route B: ALPHA_EM_INV from substrate/experimental_constants.py (CODATA-2018 Cs recoil). Tolerance 1e-9 sits under CODATA's own 2.1e-8 uncertainty, so this tests the transcription, not the measurement.

description: Tier=near-match candidate for the 32 ppm Ocneanu '12' residual: k_predicted = 12 − (α_em/π)/dim H_3 closes to 0.17% at q_0 (600× improvement over bare integer 12). Both factors structurally motivated (Bring zero-mode + Plancherel) — but NOT derived. Open categorical work needed before any wiring.

data.verdict: NEAR-MATCH (tier=near-match): k = 12 − (α_em/π)/dim H_3 closes k_required to 0.26114 ppm — a 124.545× improvement over the bare integer 12 (32 ppm). Both factors are structurally motivated: (α_em/π) is the standard EM prefactor from m_K/m_π's Bring zero-mode closure (PR #1442), and 1/dim H_3 = 1/|S_3| = 1/6 is the natural Plancherel normalization. NOT yet a derivation — the Bring-projection argument that pins the (3q²−1)/(2q²) shape in m_K/m_π hasn't been applied to the proton-mass identity. Open follow-up: derive (α_em/π)/dim H_3 from a Bring zero-mode analog. CRITICAL guard: do not promote this to production without the derivation — per production-vs-exploratory-discipline, the 0.17% precision is below the structural-identity threshold (1 ppm) but above the empirical-fit threshold (1%); it remains a tier=near-match that warrants categorical work, not wiring.

caveats: Docstring headline numbers are STALE and were left as written rather than silently corrected: it claims the residual is 3.878e-4, matched to 0.17%, a 600× improvement. This run measures 3.90270e-4, matched to 0.803%, a 124.5× improvement. The verdict string is built live and has always printed the correct 0.26114 ppm / 124.545×. The tier (near-match, inside 1%) is unchanged.

α_em is hard-typed here as 1/137.0359991 rather than read from substrate/experimental_constants.ALPHA_EM_INV. Left in place (the computed values are unchanged) and pinned by the alpha_em_literal_matches_codata_registry assertion instead.
